limitations: Only the latest passing navigation and CLI/provider runs' source/output/executable hashes are rechecked as sets. Earlier logs/results retain their original, potentially superseded source scope.
Other executable hashes are inventory at archive time, not proof that every binary was built from this source tree.
Per-log Rust test totals overlap; do not add totals across independent reruns.

Provider acceptance uses an explicitly enabled isolated synthetic transport. No live Google account, real mailbox data, external upload, Send, remote-only draft import/deletion or physical OS picker acceptance.
No Calendar concurrency, large-mailbox/search/resize, package, CI or physical-input acceptance implied.

Only allowlisted top-level generated packet logs/results/PNGs and CTest inventory/JUnit metadata are copied; no profile directories, databases, blobs, MIME, credential/config files, or executable bytes are archived.
